C1355.title: 2021 Blockchain Security Report: 80% of DAPP Security Incidents Caused by Smart Contract Vulnerabilities
C1355.summary: The 2021 blockchain security report released by Fairyproof reveals that among 189 publicly reported security incidents, DAPP-related incidents accounted for over 95%, with 80% directly caused by smart contract vulnerabilities, resulting in at least $7.6 billion in crypto asset losses.
